description:
Each player is assigned a unique ID in the range [0, 3]. This ID represents individual players
         participating in the game, with player ID 0’s data coming first and so on. For singles,
         only players 0 and 2 are used. For drills, any number of players between 1 and 4 can participate.

         
Each game can consist of one or two teams, depending on the game type:

- **Singles**: One player per team, using player 0 (team 0) and player 2 (team 1).
- **Doubles**: Two players per team, with players 0 and 1 on team 0, and players 2 and 3 on team 1.
- **Drill**: No fixed teams; between 1-4 players participate or a ball machine is used.

_Team 0 (for singles and doubles)_
* Player 0 starts the first rally from the side of the court containing the origin (far side).
* In doubles, player 1 is also on team 0.

_Team 1 (for doubles and singles)_
* Player 2 serves first for team 1.
* In doubles, player 3 is also on team 1.
title: Player ID
